name: TinyChat (AWQ on-device runtime)
notable_features: Platform-specific weight packing for 4-bit SIMD registers
Fused dequant + GEMM kernels; KV cache pre-allocated and updated inside the attention kernel
Targets edge CPUs and GPUs, not datacenter serving
hardware_caveats: W4A16 only - activations and KV cache stay FP16, so no INT4 tensor-core op is used
Quantized conv/packing order is platform-specific: a file packed for ARM SIMD is not optimal on GPU
best_for: single-stream on-device generation on consumer GPUs and ARM CPUs
avoid_for: multi-user serving - no continuous batching or request scheduling
notes: The runtime that ships with the AWQ paper, not a general-purpose engine. Recorded here because AWQ's quality numbers were produced by evaluating quantized checkpoints with this runtime's kernels and the paper's own harness; do not read TinyChat's throughput numbers as engine benchmarks. AWQ's own speed claim in the paper is >3x over HF FP16 on desktop and mobile GPUs, not the ~4x commonly quoted from Marlin. ||| MAINTENANCE (dated fact, GitHub API, 2026-10-04): last commit 2025-07-17 (14.6 months before this record), NO GitHub release or tag found, 16 contributors (distinct committers including anonymous), open_issues_count 207 (issues PLUS pull requests - see [[ev-github-open-issues-count-includes-pull-requests]]), not archived, 3645 stars.
